verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents native HCL/Terraform language support and 'pulumi import' for adopting existing resources into Pulumi state, plus a migration landing page explicitly mentioning Terraform migration. However, evidence does not show a direct import of Terraform *state* files (only resource-by-resource import against live cloud resources) and lacks hands-on/independent confirmation of a full Terraform-codebase migration workflow. missing for 10: direct Terraform state-file import mechanism, end-to-end case study/independent validation of migrating an existing Terraform codebase+state, detail on HCL program conversion fidelity.
